gloss: hot spring resort area, spa town

definitions.gloss: hot spring resort area, spa town
definitions.explanation: A town or district centered around hot springs, typically featuring ryokan (traditional inns), public baths, and shops catering to tourists.

examples.japanese: {温泉街|おんせんがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散策|さんさく}→散策：07618_sansaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To stroll around the hot spring town.

examples.japanese: {温泉街|おんせんがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ち{並|なら}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Traditional inns line the hot spring district.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{温泉街|おんせんがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: It's fun to walk around the spa town in a yukata.

notes:
A town or district built up around hot springs for visitors.

- {温泉街|おんせんがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧: the inns of a spa town

CULTURAL NOTE:
A typical {温泉街|おんせんがい} has ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧ (inns), {共同浴場|きょうどうよくじょう} (public baths), ⟦{足湯|あしゆ}→足湯：14296_ashiyu⟧ (foot baths), souvenir shops and old-style games such as ⟦{射的|しゃてき}→射的：24090_shateki⟧; guests stroll in ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧. Famous examples are {草津|くさつ} (Gunma), {別府|べっぷ} (Oita) and {城崎|きのさき} (Hyogo).
